title: Analytics Roadmap
content_html:
Analytics Roadmap

Analytics retirement is complete. Tag management belongs to Studio, document sharing belongs to integrated Docs Viewer, and tag-package sharing is retired without replacement.

suggested order feature status depends on outcome
1 Analytics App Retirement done Tag Management In Studio Analytics app/runtime removed after final ownership cutover

Paused Analytics concepts remain available for reference but are not a reason to retain the application. Source-faithful document-package work now belongs under Share Document Packages; future tag assistance belongs under Studio and remains human-mediated.

Current Position

Document sharing has moved to Docs Viewer, tag-package sharing and the generic repository Data Sharing subsystem are retired, and Studio owns canonical tags and all retained tag workflows. There is no future Analytics delivery queue; new work belongs on the roadmap of its current domain owner.
